library(dplyr)

dtx <- fb %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Brix, pH, Densidad,
    Grado_alcoholico, Acidez_total
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

mv <- FactoMineR::PCA(
  dtx,
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph = FALSE
)

var <- factoextra::fviz_pca_var(
  mv,
  col.var = "black",
  repel = TRUE,
  labelsize = 3
)

var
cos <- factoextra::fviz_pca_var(
  mv,
  col.var = "cos2",
  gradient.cols = c("red", "forestgreen", "blue"),
  repel = TRUE,
  labelsize = 3
)

cos
ind <- factoextra::fviz_pca_ind(
  mv,
  col.ind = "contrib",
  gradient.cols = c("blue", "forestgreen", "red"),
  repel = TRUE
)

ind
pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

3.1 PCA information

library(corrplot)
c1 <- factoextra::fviz_eig(mv, 
                addlabels = TRUE,
                hjust = 0.05,
                barfill="white",
                barcolor ="darkblue",
                linecolor ="red") + 
  # ylim(0, 30) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA - percentage of explained variances",
    y = "Variance (%)") +
  theme_minimal()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c1
c2 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 1, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 1 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c2
c3 <- fviz_contrib(mv,
                     choice = "var", 
                     axes = 2, 
                     top = 30,
                     fill="white",
                     color ="darkblue"
                   , sort.val = "asc"
                   ) +
  # ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(title = "Dim 2 - variables contribution", x = "") +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
    , axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

c3
lpanel <- c(c1, c2, c3) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1, labels = "auto"
            , rel_heights = c(1, 1.2, 1.2))
  
rpanel <- \() {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    tl.cex = 0.9, 
    number.cex = 0.5, 
    number.digits = 1,
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4 
  )

}

grid <- c(lpanel, rpanel) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = c("", "d"))

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/contribution.jpg"
         , units = "cm"
         , width = 28, height = 36)

plot %>% include_graphics()
